name: browy
description: Copilot-powered AI agent that lives in your browser

scripts.stage:win: npm run build:prod && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --target=win-x64 && node scripts/stage.mjs --target=win-x64
scripts.stage:mac-x64: npm run build:prod && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --target=darwin-x64 && node scripts/stage.mjs --target=darwin-x64
scripts.stage:mac-arm: npm run build:prod && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --target=darwin-arm64 && node scripts/stage.mjs --target=darwin-arm64
scripts.stage:linux: npm run build:prod && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --target=linux-x64 && node scripts/stage.mjs --target=linux-x64
scripts.stage:linux-arm: npm run build:prod && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --target=linux-arm64 && node scripts/stage.mjs --target=linux-arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run stage:win     && npm run pack:win
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run stage:mac-x64 && npm run pack:mac-x64
scripts.dist:mac-arm: npm run stage:mac-arm && npm run pack:mac-arm
scripts.dist:linux: npm run stage:linux     && npm run pack:linux
scripts.dist:linux-arm: npm run stage:linux-arm && npm run pack:linux-arm
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:win && npm run dist:mac-x64 && npm run dist:mac-arm && npm run dist:linux && npm run dist:linux-arm && npm run pack:extension

author: ritabratamaiti
